rebase_feature_branch_onto_main: rebase the current feature branch onto main to incorporate latest changes
continue_rebase_after_resolving_conflict: continue an in-progress rebase after manually resolving all merge conflicts
abort_git_rebase: abort an in-progress rebase and restore the repository to its pre-rebase state
skip_conflicting_commit_during_rebase: skip the current conflicting commit during a rebase to drop it entirely
show_git_conflict_markers: show conflict marker locations with file names and line numbers in conflicted files
